title: Colour-match the mood previews
author: claude
summary: A second script colour-matches the previews so they can be compared fairly.
what: A second script colour-matches the previews. The results are the pictures with `_graded` in their names.
why: Raw renders differ in colour and brightness in ways that hide the real difference between moods.

tech.name: Python scripts
tech.plain: Small programs that tell Blender what to build and bake, so every step can be repeated.

tech.name: Gamma and tone mapping
tech.plain: A way of squeezing very bright light into the range a screen can show.
